description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Celes (Ice)], & ATK +500 to user.
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Mode
description.text: Ice abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times and don't consume ability uses, grants [111% ATB (Tactical)] after using Ice abilities, keeps track of the number of Ice abilities used, removes [Tactical Awoken Mode] after using 8 Ice abilities, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
One single piercing attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user.
Grants [Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Ice 125% ATB (Tactical)] to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has Attach Ice 0-1/2
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: Grants [Ice Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Ice Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Ice attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Ice Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Ice Quick Cast (Tactical)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Ice while in Tactical Awoken Mode
